//: Copy to .securescan.json in your repository root. Every key here also
//exclude: exists as a command-line flag, and the flag always wins.
//failOn: Exit 1 at or above this level. 'none' always exits 0.
//minSeverity: Hide below this level in the TERMINAL report only. Findings
//minSeverity2: stay in --json and --sarif regardless - the machine output
//minSeverity3: is never allowed to be rosier than the human one.
//only: Restrict to these rule ids. Omit to run every rule.
//note: There is deliberately NO way to disable a rule here. A config that
//note2: can switch off the rules a repo fails makes findings vanish with
//note3: no record. Use securescan:ignore <rule> - <reason> on the line
//note4: instead; those are counted and listed in every report.
